title: 第25章 逆徒胆子是越来越大了第26章 丹峰师徒行
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第25章逆徒胆子是越来越大了灶房里，苏婉卿一把揪住楚宁的耳朵，脸都红到了耳根子！
“让你看修为！修为！难道看不出如今为师境界么！”
“你看什么呢！”
楚宁尴尬的有点想死。
不是！
那您也没说明白啊！
我琢磨您要展示一下的.......
楚宁急忙笑到：“恭喜师尊，贺喜师尊啊！没想到师尊刚刚重修，就已经是如今的气息，怕不是已经在体修进度上有所造诣！”
“话说师尊，这是二境了？”
苏婉卿冷笑一声：“如今倒是看出来了？”
楚宁挠头笑着：“弟子就睡了一晚，师尊进步就如此神速了，属实没猜到........”
“难道你如今三境，为师难道就猜到了？为师关注的不也是你修为境界进步，可你呢，如今脑袋里是在想什么，用得着为师挑明？”
说着，苏婉卿便是嗓音娇柔轻哼一声。
楚宁觉得这话题干脆还是过去吧。
不然实在是忒尴尬了......
“那个师尊，弟子帮忙做饭？”
“饭好了，准备吃就是了，去洗手。”
“好的师尊！”
尴尬的对话终于过去，饭桌上，二人相对而坐。
一桌丰盛的饭菜，各种肉类蔬菜都有，小竹峰这东西倒是不缺。

楚宁吃的嘎嘎香。
昨晚没吃东西，属实是饿了啊！
苏婉卿倒是一直在关注楚宁的修为。
他的进步，似乎不比自己慢。
什么时候变得这么天才了？
倒也不错。
如今不会太拖累弟子了。
之后的修为，就要继续用药材淬体了。
不过话说太玄宗的人仍然是没来？
按理说也该到了。
“宁儿，如今为是二境了，已经是尽可能的掩饰了气息，你的修为突破，也要尽可能的掩饰，对方不知道你的底牌，你的胜算才更大。”
楚宁这才想起来这回事。
这几天修为提升的忒快，忘了这茬了。
待会找系统买个掩饰修为的玩意。
楚宁点了点头。
“师尊，话说体修境界和法修境界的差别是在哪里？”
因为没有修行，楚宁也不太清楚。
苏婉卿感受了一下自身，并且是结合自己过往经历给出了判断。
“三境之前，体修碾压同境修士，到了四境之后，几乎就是被摁着打了。”
content_en:
Chapter 25 The traitor is becoming more and more courageous. In the kitchen, Su Wanqing grabbed Chu Ning's ears, her face turned red to the base of her ears!
"Let me show you your cultivation! Your cultivation! Can't you see the state of being a master now?"
"What are you looking at!"
Chu Ning was so embarrassed that she wanted to die.
no!
Then you didn’t explain it clearly!
I'm wondering what you want to show...
Chu Ning laughed hurriedly: "Congratulations, Master! Congratulations, Master! I didn't expect that Master would have the same aura as he did just after re-cultivating. I'm afraid he has already made some achievements in physical cultivation!"
"Speaking of Master, is this the second level?"
Su Wanqing sneered: "You can see it now?"
Chu Ning scratched his head and smiled: "Disciple slept for one night, and Master has made such rapid progress. I really didn't expect it..."
"Could it be that my teacher has already guessed that you are currently in the third realm? I am not concerned about your progress in cultivation, but what about you? What are you thinking in your head now? Do you need me to clarify it for you?"
As she spoke, Su Wanqing hummed softly.
Chu Ning felt that this topic should be left alone.
Otherwise it would be really embarrassing...
"Master, will the disciples help with the cooking?"
"The food is ready. Just prepare to eat. Go wash your hands."
"Okay Master!"
The awkward conversation finally passed, and the two sat opposite each other at the dinner table.
A sumptuous meal is served on the table, with all kinds of meat and vegetables, and Xiaozhufeng is not lacking in these things.
Chu Ning ate deliciously.
I didn’t eat anything last night, so I was really hungry!
Su Wanqing has been paying attention to Chu Ning's cultivation.
His progress seemed no slower than his own.
When did you become such a genius?
Not bad.
Now it won't be too much of a drag on the disciples.
In the future cultivation, you will continue to use medicinal materials to temper your body.
But the people from Taixuanzong still didn’t come?
It stands to reason that it’s time to arrive.
"Ning'er, now that you are in the second realm, you have tried your best to hide your aura. Your cultivation breakthrough must also be hidden as much as possible. If the other party doesn't know your trump card, your chances of winning will be greater."
Only then did Chu Ning remember this.
My cultivation has been improving so fast these days, I forgot about this.
I'll buy something from the system later to hide my cultivation.
Chu Ning nodded.
"Master, what is the difference between the realm of physical cultivation and the realm of legal cultivation?"
Because he didn’t practice, Chu Ning didn’t know much.
Su Wanqing felt herself and made a judgment based on her past experience.
"Before the Third Realm, physical cultivators crushed fellow monks. After reaching the Fourth Realm, they were almost pressed down and beaten."
